source_acquisition.source_budget: B=sum exact positive version-specific B_e; do not extrapolate sample 248144826-byte object.
source_acquisition.body_byte_worst_case: At most 3*B transport body bytes if every full object attempt is repeated; actual failed/partial bytes measured and retained. No bandwidth claim from this formula.
source_acquisition.storage: At least B plus sum retained failed partials + acquisition receipts. Stage independent source objects once, never duplicate per arm. A complete filesystem accounting including existing originals is required before acquisition.
source_acquisition.no_budget_now: B and native storage remain null; no finite numeric authorization for acquisition follows from an algebraic bound.

preparation.overrun: Retain failure and full scope; obtain coherent pre-execution resource/implementation amendment, never truncate events/ROIs/mice.
preparation.streaming_requirement: Future implementation can stream/spill immutable intermediate population rows without changing arithmetic/selection. Current all_cases accumulation is not proof of RAM fit.
preparation.retained_storage_formula: B + failed_partials + P + immutable reference/control/candidate artifacts + logs + runtime/checkpoint bytes + scratch peak; all terms bound by real census before each execution stage.

references.feature_resource_gate: Compute n,d and exact dense/matrix working allocation from full FIT-only vocabularies before fitting. Primary Gram memory >=8*d*d bytes per simultaneous matrix; independent weighted-design memory >=8*n*d plus SVD workspace. Enumerate actual library workspaces, threads and copies; unknown terms fail resource admission.
references.no_inference_from_bounds: These are refused-at-ceiling allocations, not performance estimates or claims of feasibility. All 35 fits are required if executing complete design; no grid pruning.

candidate_development_per_condition.allowed_training_data: All FIT/validation data in assigned information view, equal access within a matched pair; no sampling imposed by operator.

candidate_per_event.concurrency: One event capsule per allocated device at a time in the primary execution, no unmetered parallel descendants. Fresh state between every event.
candidate_per_event.failure: Timeout, malformed output, budget breach or missing event prevents complete arm grading; preserve outputs and actual cost. No default prediction substitution.

candidate_total_bounds.caution: C_query unknown; these symbolic maxima may be large and do not establish feasible total cost. Full total budget must be admitted after support census before candidate execution; insufficient resources cannot reduce panel or conditions.
candidate_total_bounds.all_candidate_retained_artifact_bytes: 34426847232+67108864*C_query; development 8*4GiB plus report 8*8MiB plus event outputs; excludes separately itemized read-only source/checkpoint/reference artifacts

checkpoint_gate: One exact locally available or separately authorized checkpoint/tokenizer/inference runtime must be pinned before development. Same identity/devices/tool environment in paired arms. No download/API/install is authorized now; if unavailable, stop at this gate. A complete design does not pretend a checkpoint was accessed.
equalization: Same allocations, data granularity, checkpoint and tool access in matched F/I arms; record realized usage as well as ceiling. R costs include common reference fit/selection costs once physically, plus per-arm inference and transparent amortized share. G does not get covert reference help.
actual_costs: V2 COST_LEDGER.json preserves V1 and correction authoring cost. Future report resources require actual per-job CPU/GPU/wall/RAM/VRAM/token/call/read/write counters and failures, aggregated with development and event inference exactly once.

candidate_narrative_per_condition.mandatory: One report job per each F/I x T/N x G/R condition after all prediction captures; terminal failure retained, no retry.
candidate_narrative_per_condition.actor: Separate post-capture report identity; same preregistered reporting recipe/checkpoint for all arms. Actual usage may be lower.
candidate_narrative_per_condition.failure: Record timeout/budget/runtime/invalid-report reason and actual usage; close all report processes and writers. No score or prediction mutation. Whole programme interpretation incomplete if any report fails.
